text: Porn, reels, betting, energy drinks. All of it fills *the silence* you can't sit in.

items.head: Phone before feet hit the floor
items.sub: Your brain starts the day already flooded.

items.head: Scrolling in bed
items.sub: No thought gets to finish before sleep.

items.head: Minutes staring at a wall
items.sub: No phone, no music. Let boredom hit.

items.head: Walk a day with no headphones
items.sub: Your own thoughts are the point.

label: WHAT HAPPENS
head: The cravings go quiet
sub: When silence stops scaring you, nothing owns you.
